title: Social services amendment 92/2026 Sb. — care services take on health tasks
summary: Zakon c. 92/2026 Sb., amending the social services act (108/2006 Sb.), is in force — main provisions from 1 Jul 2026 (split effectiveness, first parts 11 Jun 2026). Pecovatelske (care) services may now perform routine health-adjacent tasks — help with taking medication without breaking skin integrity and stoma/urine-bag handling — and UP branches gain a hardship clause for cross-border care-allowance cases.
notes: In force and applied (urgency 3). Split effectiveness per https://www.zakonyprolidi.cz/cs/2026-92 (from 11.6.2026; main parts 1.7.2026 per NRZP information no. 46-2026, https://nrzp.cz/2026/07/22/informace-c-46-2026-novela-zakona-o-socialnich-sluzbach-vstoupila-1-7-2026-v-ucinnost/ — the quote is from that summary). Market: home-care providers absorbing light health tasks need staffing, training and care-documentation tooling.
quote: běžné úkony péče o zdraví, kterými jsou pomoc při užití humánního léčivého přípravku bez porušení integrity kůže

title: Care allowance raised — grades I/II up from 1 Jan 2026 (adult I 880 to 1,300 CZK)
summary: From 1 Jan 2026 prispevek na peci rises for dependency grades I and II: adults I 880 to 1,300 CZK and II 4,900 to 5,400 CZK monthly; children I 3,300 to 4,900 CZK and II 7,400 to 8,200 CZK (grades III/IV unchanged). Enacted in zakon c. 360/2025 Sb., the JMHZ accompanying change act, which carries the novela of 108/2006 Sb.
notes: In force since 1.1.2026 and paid monthly (urgency 3, recurrence structural). Primary act: https://www.zakonyprolidi.cz/cs/2025-360 ; the cited MPSV overview (30.12.2025) states the amounts. Grade I/II recipients gaining purchasing power strengthens demand for terenni and ambulantni care services.
quote: Pro osoby starší 18 let ve stupni závislosti I se příspěvek navyšuje z 880 Kč na 1 300 Kč, ve stupni závislosti II z částky 4 900 Kč na 5 400 Kč.

title: New social services act — replacement of 108/2006 planned for 1 Jan 2031
summary: Per the government's 2026 legislative intents, MPSV is to prepare a wholly new social services act (replacing 108/2006 Sb.) by Q3 2028, with the new care-funding model and dependency assessment taking effect from January 2031. Plans reported include per-client funding, care-allowance valorization and multi-year financing instead of annual provider grants.
notes: NOT enacted — a legislative plan reported by NRZP CR (information no. 13-2026) from the government's legislative intents for 2026; dates can slip with the parliamentary calendar (cf. reg-accounting-act-cz). No Sbirka entry can exist yet — primary source will be the paragraphed draft due Q3 2028. Dated trigger >18 months out -> urgency 1.

title: EU emissions trading system review — maritime, aviation and stationary installations
summary: The European Commission will review the EU emissions trading system covering maritime, aviation and stationary installations, plus the market stability reserve, ahead of a legally required 2026 assessment. The review will also examine additional policies needed to meet EU climate targets.

title: EU green waste list update — new category cleared for cross-border recovery shipment
summary: The European Commission plans to add a waste category to the EU's green list, allowing it to be shipped between member states for recovery without extra controls. The act may also introduce contamination thresholds for green-list eligibility.

title: Eurojust regulation revision — EU impact assessment on cross-border justice cooperation
summary: The European Commission will conduct an impact assessment ahead of revising the Eurojust Regulation, which governs EU cooperation on investigating and prosecuting serious cross-border and organised crime. A recent evaluation found Eurojust effective but capable of doing more.

title: EU population and housing statistics — new data sets and metadata rules
summary: The European Commission will set technical rules for the data sets and metadata needed to implement the new EU framework Regulation on population and housing statistics. The initiative covers implementation details rather than the statistical framework itself.

title: EU energy-efficient product rules — Omnibus package to simplify compliance
summary: The European Commission plans to simplify energy-efficient product legislation through targeted amendments, informed by an implementation dialogue, a reality check, two implementation reports and an impact assessment. Areas covered include energy and tyre labelling and EPREL database registration.

summary: The European Commission will evaluate the EUR 5 billion Brexit Adjustment Reserve, which supports member states most affected by the UK's withdrawal from the EU, as legally required under the Reserve's regulation. The assessment covers relevance, effectiveness, efficiency, coherence and EU added value.

summary: The European Commission is extending the derogation allowing member states to authorise up to 5% non-organic protein feed for young organic poultry and pigs. The measure ensures the animals' amino acid needs are met during growth.

title: EU drug precursor list update — new designer precursors added
summary: The European Commission is updating the EU's list of controlled drug precursor substances, adding chemicals used in illicit drug production. The update specifically targets so-called designer precursors that have no other legitimate use.

title: EU data protection law enforcement rules — report on application and functioning
summary: The European Commission is reporting on how EU rules governing personal data use by law enforcement and criminal justice authorities are applied and functioning. The rules aim to balance data protection with better information sharing among authorities.

title: EU sustainable fishing outlook — state of play and 2027 policy directions
summary: The European Commission is assessing the state of EU fish stocks, the balance between fishing capacity and opportunities, and implementation of the landing obligation, alongside the fleet's socio-economic performance. The initiative also sets main policy orientations for 2027.

title: EU equivalence rules cleanup — removing expired third-country recognitions
summary: The European Commission is amending rules on information that third countries and control bodies must submit for equivalence recognition, removing cross-references that are no longer valid. The change removes expired rules rather than altering substantive requirements.

summary: The European Commission is setting methodological rules to ensure plastic materials collected or recycled outside the EU are assessed, verified and certified to a standard equivalent to EU material before use in packaging. The act targets imported recycled content specifically.

summary: The European Commission is setting uniform rules for calculating and verifying recycled content in plastic packaging under EU law. The act aims to give the recycling industry legal clarity to proceed with investments.

summary: The European Commission is evaluating the European Environment Agency and its European Environment Information and Observation Network for the 2022-2026 period, under the Commission's Better Regulation approach. The evaluation follows the Common Approach used for EU decentralised agencies.

summary: The European Commission is developing a roadmap to improve school education performance through 2040, addressing declining basic skills, teacher shortages, limited digital capacity and AI readiness. The plan supports member states through cooperation, teacher support and deployment measures.

summary: The European Commission is assessing its exceptional 2024-2025 macro-financial assistance to Ukraine, funded under the G7 Extraordinary Revenue Acceleration loans backed by immobilised Russian sovereign assets. The evaluation covers the operation in the context of Russia's ongoing war.
